history.note: Reviewed actual monitor take-0032 (source 2fc0922), B_house, against reference/frames/B_house.jpg. The warm arched opening and living roof detail are present, but the right-hand house does not yet match the reference proportions: its roof rises beyond the frame as a tall steep mass, whereas the reference presents a low broad dome and a much wider dark entrance beneath a heavy horizontal overhang. The doorway reads as a small narrow arch on the trunk wall. Prioritize roof silhouette/overhang and entrance width at the fixed camera before adding more vines.
